is an Indian [[home loan|housing finance]] company in the [[affordable housing]] segment based in [[Mumbai]] and founded in 2010. It provides [[home loan]]s, [[mortgage loan]]s and [[Home construction|home construction loan]]s.{{cite news |title=Home First Finance Company India Ltd |url=https://www.edelweiss.in/ewwebimages/WebFiles/Research/e0fdc1cb-8eb8-4673-ad19-136bbc1bbd28.pdf |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=Edelweiss Research}}{{cite news |title=Home First Finance |url=https://www.icicidirect.com/mailimages/IDirect_HomeFirst_IPOReview.pdf |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=ICICIdirect}} Its equity shares are listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]]. ==History== Home First Finance was founded in 2010 by former chairman and co-founder of [[Mphasis]], [[Jerry Rao]]; former CEO and MD of [[Bank of Baroda]], PS Jayakumar; and Manoj Viswanathan, who previously worked with [[Citigroup]] India.{{cite news |last1=Nandy |first1=Madhurima |title=Jaithirth Rao {{!}} The late homebody |url=https://www.livemint.com/Leisure/PK4rHP8fr3bOhsaM9puIiP/Jaithirth-Rao--The-late-homebody.html |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=mint |date=1 February 2013 |language=en}}{{cite news |title=Warburg 'looking to exit' from Home First Finance |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/warburg-in-talks-with-banks-nbfcs-for-stake-sale-in-home-first-finance/article65890507.ece |access-date=28 September 2022 |work=Business Line |agency=The Hindu}} It commenced operations in August 2010 after registering with the [[National Housing Bank]], the regulatory and licensing body for housing finance companies in India.{{cite news |title=National Housing Bank - Annual Report 2010-2011 |url=https://nhb.org.in/Publications/final_Statement_english_2010_2011.pdf | work=nhb.org.in |access-date=27 September 2022}} In 2011, [[Bessemer Venture Partners]] bought a minority stake in the company for an undisclosed sum.{{cite news |last1=Nandy |first1=Madhurima |last2=Unnikrishnan |first2=Dinesh |title=US-based Bessemer buys stake in affordable housing finance start-up |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/kVFZvkbf03ywozkHnYde1K/USbased-Bessemer-buys-stake-in-affordable-housing-finance-s.html |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=mint |date=9 June 2011 |language=en}} In 2013, [[Tata Capital|Tata Capital Growth Fund]] picked up a minority stake in the company. Home First Finance turned profitable in 2014.{{cite news |last1=Sinha |first1=Shilpy |title=Home First Finance Company is looking to sell 30% stake for Rs 250 crore to fund operations |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/home-first-finance-company-is-looking-to-sell-30-stake-for-rs-250-crore-to-fund-operations/articleshow/53107360.cms |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=The Economic Times}} In February 2017, [[private equity]] firm True North acquired a [[majority stake]] in Home First Finance for over {{INR}}600 crore. A co-investor in this round, Aether (Mauritius) Limited, an affiliate of the Singaporean [[sovereign wealth fund]] [[GIC (Singaporean sovereign wealth fund)|GIC]], also became part of the company's [[Corporate promoter|promoter group]] with True North.{{cite news |title=True North to invest $100 mn in Home First Finance |url=https://www.vccircle.com/true-north-invest-100-mn-home-first-finance |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=VCCircle}}{{cite news |last1=Kumar |first1=Arun |title=Private equity firm True North looks to buy major stake in Home First Finance Company for Rs 600 crore |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/private-equity-firm-true-north-looks-to-buy-major-stake-in-home-first-finance-company-for-rs-600-crore/articleshow/57363427.cms |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=The Economic Times}} In October 2020, [[Warburg Pincus]] acquired a 25% stake in Home First Finance for {{INR}}700 crore.{{cite news |title=Warburg Pincus invests Rs 700 cr to acquire stake in Home First Finance |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/warburg-pincus-invests-rs-700-cr-to-acquire-stake-in-home-first-finance-120100200425_1.html |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=Business Standard |date=2 October 2020 |language=en}} In January 2021, Warburg Pincus increased its stake to 30.62% ahead of Home First Finance's initial public offering.{{cite news |title=Warburg Pincus ups stake in Home First Finance ahead of Rs 1,000-cr IPO |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/market/ipo-news/warburg-pincus-ups-stake-in-home-first-finance-ahead-of-rs-1000-cr-ipo/2170758/ |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=Financial Express |language=en}} In January 2021, Home First Finance launched its [[initial public offering]] (IPO) of {{INR}}1,154 crore;{{cite news |title=Home First Finance Company IPO subscribed 27 times, QIB portion booked 52 times on final day |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/home-first-finance-company-ipo-subscribed-2-9-times-qib-portion-booked-1-9-times-on-final-day-6392531.html |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=Moneycontrol |language=en}} the IPO was subscribed over 26 times. Equity shares of the company began trading on [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] on 3 February 2021.{{cite news |title=Home First Finance debuts at 19% premium over issue price |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/home-first-finance-debuts-at-20-premium-over-issue-price/articleshow/80662255.cms |access-date=27 September 2022 |work=The Economic Times}} In December 2021, [[Union Bank of India]] (UBI) and Home First Finance entered into a strategic co-lending partnership.{{cite web | url=https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/union-bank-partners-with-home-first-finance-company-to-offer-home-loans-check-benefits-11639715986037.html | title=Union Bank partners with Home First Finance to offer home loans: Check benefits | date=17 December 2021 }} Home First Finance signed a similar partnership with [[Central Bank of India]] in September 2022{{cite news |title=Central Bank of India signs co-lending partnership with HFFC |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/central-bank-of-india-signs-co-lending-partnership-with-hffc-122090700817_1.html |access-date=8 August 2024 |work=Business Standard}} and [[Axis Bank]] in 2025. In December 2022, Home First Finance raised {{INR}}280 crore from [[International Finance Corporation]] to provide financing for [[green affordable housing]] customers.{{cite news |last1=Anand |first1=Saurav |title=Home First Finance raises ₹280 crore from IFC |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/home-first-finance-raises-rs-280-crore-from-ifc-11671872187692.html |access-date=8 June 2023 |work=mint |date=24 December 2022 |language=en}} In May 2024, the company's [[assets under management]] crossed {{INR}}10,000 crore.{{cite web |title=HomeFirst achieves ₹10000 Crore AUM |url=https://homefirstindia.com/files/Home%20First%20AUM%20-%2010000%20crores.pdf |publisher=Home First Finance Company India Ltd. |access-date=8 August 2024}} In April 2025, Home First Finance raised {{INR}}1,250 crore through a [[qualified institutional placement]] (QIP), which saw participation from investors including [[International Finance Corporation]], [[Capital Group Companies|Capital World]], [[Fidelity International|Fidelity Funds]] and [[HDFC Bank|HDFC Mutual Fund]].{{cite news |last1=Kumar |first1=Chitranjan |title=HomeFirst Finance raises ₹1,250 cr via QIP; IFC, Fidelity Funds, HDFC MF, among investors |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/business-news/homefirst-finance-raises-1250-cr-via-qip-ifc-fidelity-funds-hdfc-mf-among-investors/122183 |access-date=26 June 2025 |work=Fortune India |date=14 April 2025 |language=en}} ==Finances== {| class="wikitable" !Year{{cite news |title=Integrated Annual Report 2022-23 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/805049d7-37f9-4554-b3c3-0f6b86fa5068.pdf |access-date=8 June 2023 |work=BSE}} !Revenue

The company's [[corporate social responsibility]] project, titled Project Sashakt, is focused on the upliftment of migrant worker communities in [[Ahmedabad]].{{cite news |title=Home First Finance Company Q4FY25 Investor Presentation |url=https://homefirstindia.com/files/HomeFirst%20Investor%20Presentation%20Q4FY25.pdf |access-date=10 July 2025 |work=HomeFirst}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * {{Official website|https://homefirstindia.com}} {{Financial services in India}} [[Category:Housing finance companies of India]] [[Category:Financial services companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Financial services companies established in 2010]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 2010]] [[Category:2010 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:2021 initial public offerings]] [[Category:Warburg Pincus companies]]
extract: Home First Finance Company India Limited is an Indian housing finance company in the affordable housing segment based in Mumbai and founded in 2010. It provides home loans, mortgage loans and home construction loans. Its equity shares are listed on Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange.
